picks.title: Thai Customs Seizes More Than 3.1 Tonnes of Elephant Ivory Worth More Than 155 Million Baht Hidden Inside Timber at Laem Chabang Port
picks.memo: Laem Chabang Port (Chonburi): 3.1+ tonnes of ivory and tails hidden in modified timber from Zambia, ~155 million baht; announced Oct 26 by Customs DG with DSI.

picks.title: Brit in Pattaya crash as car catches fire, red-light run alleged
picks.memo: ~2am Oct 26, South Pattaya intersection on Sukhumvit (Bangkok-bound): MG carrying British man overturned, briefly caught fire, at least 2 injured; witnesses allege red-light run.

picks.title: Pattaya officials mediate dispute over bar bill involving two American men
picks.memo: Jomtien, Oct 23: two American men at a bar from ~9am to evening accused of refusing to pay; municipal officers and Pattaya City police mediated at the station.

picks.title: Pattaya Mayor Inspects Bali Hai Pier Public Toilets as Renovation Nears Completion
picks.memo: Mayor Poramese inspected Bali Hai Pier public toilet renovation on Oct 26; about 90% complete.

picks.title: Knock on the door coming for 10k visa overstayers now in Thailand as police launch new crackdown
picks.memo: Immigration chief Lt Gen Nopasin orders nationwide hunt for 10,000+ visa overstayers; raids netted South Korean fraud suspects among others; 81,000+ foreigners refused entry since Oct 2025.

picks.title: Israeli man arrested in Bangkok on drug, overstay charges after police probe suspected sex crimes
picks.memo: Oct 23, Huai Khwang condo: 54-year-old Israeli and Thai woman arrested; meth seized; he overstayed 2,095 days, also refused drug test.

picks.title: Thailand to require ID for paid social media ads from November
picks.memo: 'No ID, No Ads' from Nov 1: platforms must verify identity of paid advertisers targeting Thailand, incl. overseas; ordinary posts not affected; anti-scam measure.

picks.title: Indian passenger arrested with £50,000 and US$10,000 in cash at Suvarnabhumi Airport
picks.memo: Oct 16 arrival from Mumbai; undeclared sterling and USD worth THB 2,578,690; exchange-control violation.

picks.title: Flash floods send rocks and mud through Phuket’s Patong
picks.memo: ~03:05 Oct 26, Na Nai area of Patong (Kathu): flash flood carried rocks/mud, damaged homes, shops, cars; machinery and volunteers clearing.

picks.title: Bang Na land prices jump 39% as east Bangkok growth accelerates
picks.memo: REIC Q3 2026: Phra Khanong-Bang Na-Suan Luang-Prawet land prices +39%; Bangkok & vicinity index 459.0, +2.6% YoY, +4.1% QoQ.

picks.title: Belavia launches direct Minsk-Bangkok flights, Phuket next
picks.memo: Belavia weekly Minsk-Bangkok scheduled flights; first flight B2 799 landed Suvarnabhumi Oct 25 5.05pm; Phuket route from Oct 29.

picks.title: Thai army ready to respond if Myanmar fire damages Thai lives or property
picks.memo: Mae Sot: Naresuan Force outlines 4 measures over bullets/shells crossing from Myanmar fighting — military, diplomatic, civilian protection/compensation, humanitarian.

picks.title: Police seek account operator over Anutin's fake bribery payment
picks.memo: Former Move Forward member reportedly identified behind Facebook page posting fake 7 million baht bank slip claiming bribe to PM Anutin.

picks.title: 15 trees felled at Rama 9 memorial in Chiang Mai park
picks.memo: Parks dept to take legal action against at least 7 people for cutting 15 trees incl. 11 wild Himalayan cherry at Rama 9 memorial, Doi Suthep-Pui.
